note: Recipes for the public goldens (oracle.make_goldens). Every base is a public spectrum (JAS mmc2, Archaeometry SI, numbered standard/high-res pairs) or a generator. 'recipe' moves a base with synth.synthesise; 'asserts' name the branch each case exists to test and are re-checked at every regeneration. Feature names: m.<CONS3 component>, m.ryder, E.<band> (E.NH1545c: the OH-corrected 1545 nm trough, read on its projection; u = -E / 0.60), wax1766, wax1217, ester2254, plaster1446, plaster1945, c1_excess.

cases.name: rc_flat_none_low_m
cases.purpose: flat bands lead (evidence none) with a low reading; ZooMS pattern A

cases.name: rc_flat_none_m_ge3
cases.purpose: Codex HIGH-1: evidence none + CONS3 >= 3 -> Unlikely, model reading in the details

cases.name: rc_good_positive_all_six
cases.purpose: model Good, all six bands lit and clean -> positive-signs line (a)

cases.name: rc_borderline_1p2_positive_all_six
cases.purpose: DECISIONS 52 example: 1.2% reading, all six lit, clean -> Borderline + positive signs (a)

cases.name: rc_borderline_1p2_sign_no_line
cases.purpose: the same scan with an ester sign: flag only, verdict unchanged, no positive-signs line

cases.name: rc_positive_clear_m_1p5
cases.purpose: positive signs (b): clear bands, pattern D (not all six), CONS3 >= 1

cases.name: rc_positive_clear_m_0p9_no_line
cases.purpose: positive signs (b) needs CONS3 >= 1: at 0.9 no line

cases.name: rc_lift_good
cases.purpose: lift: strong bands, all six readable and lit, clean, CONS3 low -> Good

cases.name: rc_lift_borderline
cases.purpose: lift: clear bands, all six lit, clean, CONS3 < 0.5 -> Borderline

cases.name: rc_lift_blocked_ester
cases.purpose: lift blocked by an ester sign; the model verdict stands; flag shown

cases.name: rc_lift_blocked_wax_unlikely
cases.purpose: lift blocked by a wax sign on an Unlikely reading; Unlikely stands with the flag

cases.name: rc_lift_burnt_still_lifts
cases.purpose: DECISIONS 53: burnt does not block a lift; burnt flag shown

cases.name: rc_lift_blocked_gated
cases.purpose: B6b-gated scan: signs not run, lift blocked as too noisy, contaminants_not_checked

cases.name: rc_plus_d
cases.purpose: +D: CONS3 >= 3 but both protein bands readable and flat -> Borderline

cases.name: rc_plus_d_with_flag
cases.purpose: +D together with a contaminant sign: the +D note first, the flag beside it, verdict unchanged

cases.name: rc_flag_on_good_wax
cases.purpose: a wax sign on a Good scan: verdict unchanged, flag, C1 skipped, no positive line

cases.name: rc_flag_on_borderline_plaster
cases.purpose: a plaster sign on a Borderline scan: verdict unchanged, flag

cases.name: rc_flag_on_unlikely_c1
cases.purpose: a C1 (foreign organic) sign on an Unlikely scan: Unlikely stays, flag

cases.name: rc_burnt_only_borderline
cases.purpose: burnt only: flag_burnt, verdict unchanged, positive-signs line still shown

cases.name: rc_models_disagree
cases.purpose: components straddle the 3 cut (different verdict bands) -> models_disagree (shown before positive signs)

cases.name: rc_s_null_bands_too_noisy
cases.purpose: no core band readable: S = null; bands too noisy to judge

cases.name: zooms_pattern_C_bison
cases.purpose: ZooMS pattern C (one protein band) -> Borderline

cases.name: zooms_pattern_B
cases.purpose: ZooMS pattern B (protein flat, C-H only) -> Unlikely; radiocarbon model verdict

cases.name: hires_longwave_not_assessed
cases.purpose: high-res, long-wave tail too noisy: B9 and C1 run their truncated variants (long-wave policy); S1_R2 shown

cases.name: hires_switch_flipped_to_std
cases.purpose: the instrument class is the user's switch: the same high-res-like spectrum scored as Standard (no transfer)

cases.name: pair22_hires
cases.purpose: real high-res scan (numbered pair, unlabelled): transfer v0.2, S1_R2, noise gates

cases.name: pair22_std
cases.purpose: its standard-resolution partner

cases.name: serial_preset_mismatch
cases.purpose: a serial the registry knows as high-res, scored as Standard by the user's switch: gentle note

cases.name: not_bone_sine
cases.purpose: B9 below the cut -> Doesn't look like bone

cases.name: rescan_white_panel
cases.purpose: B4 white panel -> Rescan

cases.name: rescan_empty_probe_dark_scan
cases.purpose: B4 mean R < 0.03 -> Rescan (a real, very dark public scan)

cases.name: rescan_impossible_R
cases.purpose: B3 R <= 0 inside 1000-2450 nm -> Rescan

cases.name: unsupported_joins
cases.purpose: detector joins other than 1000/1800 -> unsupported

cases.name: notes_B7_B8
cases.purpose: B7 reflectance above 1 and B8 splice step (notes only; verdict unaffected)

cases.name: check_B8_large_step
cases.purpose: B8 splice step > 15% -> Check (a detector or fibre fault; verdict unaffected)

cases.name: note_B5_dark
cases.purpose: B5 very dark spot (note)

cases.name: b6_check_hires_noisy
cases.purpose: B6: implied SD > 0.5 points -> Check (high-res, noisy SWIR2); B6b gated

cases.name: asd_file_std
cases.purpose: Step 1 reader: an as8 file built from a public spectrum (header, OLE time, UTC offset, serial preset)

cases.name: asd_file_saturated
cases.purpose: B2 raw DN >= 65,000 -> Rescan

cases.name: asd_file_other_joins
cases.purpose: Step 1 matrix: joins 1000/1830 -> unsupported

cases.name: hires_c1_gated_plaster_checked
cases.purpose: per-sign gates (phase 0c): high-res, transfer v0.2, N2(2000-2100) between 125 and 150: C1 gated, plaster checked; the lift needs all four checked

cases.name: hires_ester_gated
cases.purpose: per-sign gates: high-res, N2(2220-2245) above 250: ester gated, the other signs checked

cases.name: hires_longwave_300_c1_truncated
cases.purpose: long-wave N2 above 250: B9 and C1 truncated; c1_reduced in the details only

cases.name: soft_c1_just_over
cases.purpose: soft tier: C1 excess just over its soft line (6.6), no hard sign: possible_thin_coating, no positive-signs line, verdict unchanged

cases.name: soft_c1_just_under
cases.purpose: soft tier: C1 excess just under its soft line: no note, the positive-signs line stays

cases.name: soft_ester_just_over
cases.purpose: soft tier: ester just over its soft line (13.1)

cases.name: soft_plaster_just_over
cases.purpose: soft tier: plaster joint load just over its soft line (0.026)

cases.name: soft_ineligible_noisy_hires
cases.purpose: soft tier: a high-res scan with N2(2000-2100) above 60 is not eligible, even with its signs checked

cases.name: above_bone_range_cons3_21
cases.purpose: CONS3 above 20%: the above_bone_range note on every analysis (note only)

cases.name: ev_1545_lit_blocks_none
cases.purpose: the OH-corrected 1545 band lit (u 1.6 >= 1.5): no longer every core band flat, so not 'none'

cases.name: ev_1545_unlit_keeps_none
cases.purpose: the 1545 band below its lit line (u 1.4): flat, the level stays 'none'; the ZooMS vote (> 1.25 u) still turns Unlikely into Borderline

cases.name: zooms_vote_1545
cases.purpose: ZooMS vote: both protein bands flat (pattern Unlikely) but the 1545 trough lit: ZooMS Borderline; the vote is ZooMS-only, so radiocarbon/isotopes still read the pattern verdict Unlikely and +D holds

cases.name: zooms_vote_1545_rc_unaffected
cases.purpose: the ZooMS-only vote at a Borderline model reading: ZooMS Unlikely -> Borderline, radiocarbon/isotopes exactly as without the vote (model verdict, pattern verdict Unlikely)

cases.name: zooms_ryder_line
cases.purpose: the Ryder 2045 ZooMS line: Unlikely, no band line, Ryder 2045 >= 0.34, no lift-blocking sign
